subject: Chemistry
title: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry
summary: Oxidation = electrons khona (oxidation number badhta hai); reduction = electrons lena (oxidation number ghatta hai). Dono hamesha saath hote hain — redox reaction.
Galvanic cell spontaneous redox reaction ko bijli mein badalta hai: anode par oxidation, cathode par reduction. Iska emf E°cell = E°cathode − E°anode, aur ΔG° = −nFE°cell.
Nernst equation kisi bhi concentration par cell ya electrode potential deti hai; equilibrium par Ecell = 0, jo E° ko equilibrium constant se jodta hai.
Electrolytic cells bijli se reactions chalaate hain (Faraday's laws). Solutions ka conductance (κ, Λm) aur Kohlrausch's law electrochemistry ko ion mobility aur degree of dissociation se jodte hain.

formulas.name: Oxidation number rules
formulas.formula: free element 0;  F −1;  O −2 (peroxide −1, OF₂ +2);  H +1 (metal hydride −1);  sum = charge of species
formulas.mistake: Peroxides (H₂O₂, Na₂O₂) mein O ka −1 hai — wahan −2 mat lo.

formulas.name: Balancing redox (ion–electron method)
formulas.formula: split into half-reactions → balance atoms other than O, H → O with H₂O → H with H⁺ (OH⁻ in base) → charge with e⁻ → add
formulas.when: Koi bhi redox equation balance karna.

formulas.name: Standard cell emf
formulas.mistake: Dono ke reduction potentials lo — sign palat kar phir se subtract mat karo.

formulas.name: Gibbs energy and emf
formulas.mistake: Positive E°cell ⇒ negative ΔG° ⇒ spontaneous — sign check karo.

formulas.name: Nernst equation
formulas.formula: E = E° − (0.0591/n) log Q  at 298 K
formulas.mistake: Q mein product/reactant concentrations; pure solids aur liquids nahi aate — mat daalo.

formulas.name: E° and equilibrium constant
formulas.formula: log K = n E°cell / 0.0591;  ΔG° = −2.303 RT log K
formulas.when: Cell reaction kitni aage jaati hai.

formulas.name: Faraday's first law
formulas.formula: m = Z I t = (M/nF) × I t
formulas.mistake: 1 F = 96500 C = 1 mol electrons ka charge — yaad rakho, bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Faraday's second law
formulas.formula: m₁/m₂ = E₁/E₂ (equivalent masses) for the same charge

formulas.name: Conductivity and molar conductivity
formulas.formula: κ = 1/ρ = G × (l/A);  Λm = κ × 1000 / C  (κ in S cm⁻¹, C in mol L⁻¹, Λm in S cm² mol⁻¹)

formulas.name: Variation with concentration
formulas.formula: strong electrolyte: Λm = Λ°m − A√C;  weak electrolyte: Λm rises steeply on dilution

formulas.name: Kohlrausch's law
formulas.formula: Λ°m = ν₊λ°₊ + ν₋λ°₋;  Λ°(CH₃COOH) = Λ°(HCl) + Λ°(CH₃COONa) − Λ°(NaCl)
formulas.when: Weak electrolytes ki limiting molar conductivity.

topics.title: Types of redox reactions
topics.explain: Combination, decomposition, displacement (metal aur non-metal) aur disproportionation, jahan ek hi element oxidise bhi hota hai aur reduce bhi: 3Cl₂ + 6OH⁻ → 5Cl⁻ + ClO₃⁻ + 3H₂O; 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂.

topics.title: Redox titrations
topics.explain: Acid mein KMnO₄ (MnO₄⁻ → Mn²⁺, 5e⁻) self-indicator hai; K₂Cr₂O₇ (Cr₂O₇²⁻ → 2Cr³⁺, 6e⁻) ko indicator chahiye. n-factor = har formula unit par exchange hue electrons.

topics.title: Electrochemical series
topics.explain: Zyada negative E° wali metals strong reducing agents hain aur neeche wali metals ko displace karti hain (Zn, Cu ko). Paani mein F₂ sabse strong oxidising agent, Li sabse strong reducing agent.

topics.title: Galvanic cell anatomy
topics.explain: Anode: oxidation, negative terminal. Cathode: reduction, positive terminal. Salt bridge (agar mein KCl/KNO₃) circuit poora karta hai aur solutions ko neutral rakhta hai. Electrons wire se anode → cathode.

topics.title: Products of electrolysis
topics.explain: Cathode par zyada reduction potential wali species reduce hoti hai; anode par jo sabse aasaani se oxidise ho. Aqueous NaCl: cathode par H₂, anode par Cl₂ (overpotential). Molten NaCl: Na aur Cl₂. Inert (Pt) vs active (Cu) electrode anode reaction badal dete hain.

topics.title: Batteries
topics.explain: Primary (recharge nahi): dry cell (Zn anode, MnO₂ cathode), mercury cell (constant 1.35 V). Secondary (rechargeable): lead storage battery (Pb anode, PbO₂ cathode, H₂SO₄), Ni–Cd. Fuel cells (H₂–O₂) fuel ki energy seedha high efficiency se badalte hain.

topics.title: Corrosion
topics.explain: Rusting electrochemical hai: anodic spots par iron oxidise, cathodic spots par oxygen reduce, Fe₂O₃·xH₂O banta hai. Bachaav: paint, galvanising (zinc coating — sacrificial protection) ya zyada active metal se jodna.

topics.title: Conductance basics
topics.explain: Metallic conduction electrons se, temperature badhne par ghatta hai; electrolytic conduction ions se, temperature badhne par badhta hai. Cell constant = l/A, known conductivity wale KCl se nikaalte hain.

ratta: OIL RIG: oxidation is loss, reduction is gain of e⁻.
Anode: oxidation (− in galvanic, + in electrolytic).
